MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.

4. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

6. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

8. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.

9. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   D. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Songs PERFORMING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
